translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Wontti hananabaan c'eek'ettoppa; wontti ahanabaa neeni erakka.
Neena hara Asay galatooppe attina, neeni neena neerekka galatoppa; Asay ne diraw markkattoppe attina, neeni ne keekkatetsaa odoppa.
Shuchchay wolk'k'aama tookuwaa; shafetuwaa tookkiyaawekka dees'ee; shin booza uray dentsiyaa walassay unttunttu laa"uwaappekka dees'ee.
Hank'k'oo k'areti baawa; yiluukka bayzziyaa di'uwaa mala; shin k'anaatiyaan ubbaa gatsoppo.
Geemmeedda siik'uwaappe baliyaa wode k'onc'c'iyaan seeriyaawe keeka.
Morkkii neena daro gede yeriyaawaappe siik'uu neena dechchiyaawe keeka.
Kalleedda uraa eessaa ililuu iitee; shin koshateedda uraa c'ammiyaabaykka mal"ee.
Bare golliyaa aggiide yuuyyiyaa asay, bare golliyaappe haakkaade paalliyaa kafatti mala.
Shittuunne sawiyaa is'aanay asaa nashechchiyaawaadan, siik'uwaa laggiyaa zoriikka nashechchee.
Ne siik'o laggiyaanne ne aawuwaa siik'o laggiyaa aggoppa; neena meteedda wode ne ishaa golle booppa. Haakuwaan de'iyaa ishaappe matan de'iyaa shooruu keeka.
Ta na'aw, neeni aad'd'eeda eranchcha gida. Yaatintto taani nashettananne taana boriyaawanttu ooshaakka zaarana.
C'inc'c'a Asay metuu yiyaa wode be'iide k'osettee; shin akeekay pac'c'eedda Asay sitti gi biide, metuwaan gelee; yaatiide guyyeppe ayee ana yaagee.
Erenna asaw waasiyaa geliyaa uraa mayuwaa k'aari akkite; imatsaa asaw, waasiyaa geleedda uraa mayuwaa oyk'k'ite.
Wontta guuran bare k'aalaa d'ok'k'u ootsiide, bare shooruwaa sarotiyaawe Aa shek'k'iyaawaa mala.
Walak'ettaade duus's'enna machchatanne iray bukkiyaa wode s'okiide aggena gollii itti mala.
C'arkkuwaa te"anaw woy zayitiyaa c'uuc'c'uumiide oyk'k'anaw danddayettennawaadan, izo c'o"u ootsanaw danddayettenna.
Biratay birataa poshiyaawaadan, Asay ittuu ittuwaappe tamaaree.
Balasiyaa giyaa mitsatto ishalissiide naageedda uray I ayifiyaa maana; barena ayisseeddaawaa kabboyiyaa k'oomay bonchchettana.
Haatsay masttootiyaadan som"uwaa bessiyaawaadan, asaa wozanay izaaw eeshshaa bessee.
Hayk'uunne bashshay kalli erikkino; hewaadankka, asaa ayfii kallenna.
Biraynne work'k'ay taman paac'ettiide geeyiyaawaadan, asaykka bare akkiyaa galatan paac'ettee.
Booza asaa katsanna udulan yeggaade, udula mitsan c'addintto, aappe boozatetsay kichchenna.
Ne dorssatuu de'iyaa hanotaa loytsaade era; ne mehiyaa wudiyaakka wozanaappe heemma.
Ayaw gooppe, duretetsay med'inaw de'enna; kallachchaykka yeletaappe yeletaw aad'd'ennan agganaw danddayee.
Mela maatay buuc'etteeddawaappe, aac'a maatay keseeddawaappenne deriyaa bollan de'iyaa maatay shiik'eeddawaappe guyyiyaan,
dorssatuwaa isikiyaappe neeni new mayiyaawaa kessana; amareeda deeshshatuwaa zal"eedda birankka new gadiyaa shammana.
Attiyaa deeshshatuwaa maatsay new, ne soo asawunne ne mac'c'a k'oomatoo k'uma gidanawaa.
